evals.prompt: Create a 15-second dynamic motion video that showcases your strength as a motion designer. It is for a neighborhood library's evening reading event. Keep it clean, with large readable text and subtle original procedural sound. Use these exact lines: 'Make room for a story', 'Evening reading at your library', 'Thursday, 7 pm'. I want expressive connected animation, not slides with fade-in/fade-out. Avoid psychedelic shader effects and do not copy the bundled motion-study video's theme, wording, or sequence. Export at 640x360 and 30 fps.
evals.expected_output: A library-specific direction and 15-second rendered film with readable supplied copy, connected purposeful motion, and audible procedural sound, plus honest visual/playback validation. Human review assesses communication and choreography; technical checks alone do not prove visual quality.
expectations: Project duration is 15 seconds and export is 640x360 at 30 fps with 450 frames
All three supplied lines are implemented as rendered text and keyframes are provided for legibility review
Export contains a decoded non-silent audio track
The direction and source use the library brief rather than copying the bundled study's wording or sequence
A beat sheet describes evolving visual relationships and handoffs beyond opacity entrances
